startupProtocol: Read AGENTS.md and UBERBOND_CANON.md before using chat memory as project truth.
Refresh live main and inspect open or recently merged shared PRs before selecting work.
Read UBERBOND_BOOTSTRAP.json, docs/UBERBOND_MASTER_MEMORY.md, artifacts/uberbond-memory-index.json, and every remaining path listed in canonPointers.
Load the AI Employee Company Charter plus the Sol Company Brain and Claude Software Factory executive prompts before narrowing the company to a short-term task.
Read docs/memory/UBERBOND_CHECKPOINT_2026-08-30.md before CURRENT_HANDOFF; the checkpoint explicitly supersedes stale short-term claims and stale memory-index entries it names.
For Claude engineering work, read docs/memory/CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_2026-08-30.md plus the canonical Claude executive mission before acting.

Read docs/AI_SKILL_PLUGIN_ASSIMILATION_CANON.md, docs/CAPABILITY_GENOME_CANON.md, docs/WALLBREAKER_CANON.md, artifacts/external-skill-plugin-registry.json, and the capability control planes before installing, invoking, acquiring, promoting, or revoking external capabilities or solving a material stuck mission.
Run/read npm run capabilities:doctor in a real repository host before relying on optional external runtimes; project-native skill presence and host runtime activation are different evidence classes.

Run/read npm run capabilities:genome:doctor before world capability discovery or selection; creator counts, measured seed records, world corpus imports, approvals, activation, and runtime health are different evidence classes.

When a material mission is stuck, repeatedly failing, capability-constrained, verifier-constrained, or has multiple materially different solution families, use Wallbreaker to compile, diversify, classify failures, falsify assumptions, and replan before repeating the same mechanism.
Capability Genome atom IDs used by Wallbreaker must be explicit or produced by a separately verified mapping; never guess an atom ID from a human capability label.
Read docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json after master memory and checkpoint so the short-term frontier cannot erase the long-term company dream.
Read docs/CURRENT_SYSTEM_STATE.md and artifacts/system-readiness.json for current measured readiness.
Search namedInitiatives and unresolvedNames before concluding an older program or feature never existed.
Dedupe requested work against current main and active shared branches.
Select the highest-value dependency-satisfied unfinished mission that advances risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute.
Execute inside the consequence charter, verify the exact head, and leave a durable handoff after material work.
